meaning:
1) eminence, lofty horns, summit
1a) eminence (of towering horns, peaks, silver)

renderings.kjv: he hath as it were the strength
he hath as it were the strength

elsewhere.note: God brings them out of Egypt. He has as it were the strength of the wild ox.
The Almighty will be your treasure, and precious silver to you.
In his hand are the deep places of the earth. The heights of the mountains are also his.
